summary.en: A shared name, a shared set of records, and people who may leave. The name often outlasts the lineup.
summary.zh: 共用一个名字、一批唱片；成员可以换。名字常常比阵容活得久。

body.en:
A band starts when a few players agree on a name and put it on a flyer. Then the name sticks. Members quit, get fired, die, or rejoin for a tour. The logo stays on shirts and radio playlists.

Led Zeppelin broke up; the records still circulate. Nirvana stopped; the quiet-loud dynamic still shows up in garage bands. That is the point: a band is not "a singer plus backing." It is temporary chemistry frozen onto vinyl, CD, or files.

On this site, "decisive" does not mean "best." It means later bands had to react. The Beatles made the album the main unit. Black Sabbath made heavy guitar the default language for metal. Those reactions fill the timeline.

Start with something you already like. Then ask: who else was around when this sound solidified?
body.zh:
几个人定个名字、印上传单，乐队就算成立。然后名字会留下来。成员会走、会被炒、会死、会为巡演回来。Logo 还在 T 恤和电台里。

Led Zeppelin 解散了，唱片还在转。Nirvana 停了，强弱对比还在教车库乐队。要点是：乐队不是「主唱加伴奏」。它是一段被冻进黑胶、CD 或文件里的临时化学反应。

本站说「决定性」，不是「史上最强」。意思是后来的乐队不得不回应。Beatles 把专辑做成主要单位；Black Sabbath 把重型吉他写成金属的默认语言。这些回应铺满时间轴。

从你已经喜欢的东西开始。然后问：这个声音定型时，周围还有谁？
